paper.title: Magnesium silicate condensation in sub-Neptune envelopes: the fundamental link between chemistry, structure, and observables

extractor.method: SVG vector polylines selected by panel geometry, exact species RGB, and published convective/non-convective line widths; physical values are calibrated from printed ticks and clipped to the visible gas panel

censoring_contract.interpretation: A floor contact is a clipping boundary, not an equality measurement. Abundance below the floor is unavailable.
censoring_contract.gap_handling: If a curve exits and later re-enters the visible rectangle, the visible runs receive different segment_index values and are never connected or interpolated across the censored interval.
censoring_contract.boundary_points: A line-floor crossing is the geometric intersection of the published straight vector segments with the plot boundary.

limitations: These are vertices of the published artwork, not an author-supplied numerical model table.
The PDF-generation pipeline may have simplified smooth paths before publication.
No values are inferred between visible vertices except the geometric point where a straight vector segment crosses the plot boundary.
A species absent from a panel has no visible curve above the 10^-18 plot floor; absence does not establish zero abundance.
Figure 5 left is the Figure 2 left fiducial model and is stored only once.
The published gas normalization need not equal an independently implemented chemical-network normalization.
